arStrings.szText: Ultimate Skill: Create a Clone of yourself.

Minimum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} is increased by {c_number}{SF_26}{/c} as long as {c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} is present. {c_important}Shadow Clone's{/c} duration is increased by {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} seconds and deals {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.

{c_label}Passive:{/c} After spending {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} Energy, your next {c_important}Core{/c} Skill Cast becomes a {c_important}Shade{/c} Skill and spawns a {c_important}Shade{/c} that deals {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|%|]{/c} of its damage.

{c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} is now also a {c_important}Shade{/c} Skill and its duration is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} becomes a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill and now summons a stationary shadow that fires {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} piercing arrows every {c_number}[{SF_19}|1|]{/c} seconds. Each arrow deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_PROJECTILE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} gains {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} additional Charges, and its Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} seconds. You may have up to {c_number}[SF_8]{/c} {c_important}Shadow Clones{/c} active at a time.

Casting {c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}. While any {c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} is active, you gain {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} per {c_number}{SF_38}{/c} second.
Casting {c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} makes all Nearby enemies {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} and {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Shadow Clone's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} engulfs you in its visage granting {c_number}[SF_7*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for the duration.
